title: Pokémon
overview: Pocket Monsters, or Pokémon for short. These arethe mysterious and wondrous creatures of this planet. They can be seen everywhere in the world—in the sky, in the sea, in the forests, in the cities.Ash and Pikachu continue their adventures, going wherever the wind takes them and wherever their hearts lead them, chasing the unfulfilled dream of becoming a "Pokémon Master."Encounters with wild Pokémon along the way—andTeam Rocket's pursuit, aiming to steal Pikachu.Ash and Pikachu were continuing their usual adventurous days, but one day in a forest, they encountered a wounded legendary Pokémon, Latias ...!
